content: बन्ध्य [बन्ध्-यत्] .²1 To be bound or fettered, to be confined or imprisoned; अबन्ध्यं यश्च बध्नाति बद्धं यश्च प्रमुञ्चति <ls>Y. 2. 243</ls>. .²2 To be joined or bound together. .²3 To be formed, built or constructed. .²4 Detained, under arrest. .²5 (= वन्ध्य) Barren, unproductive, fruitless, useless (said of persons or things); बन्ध्यश्रमास्ते <ls>R. 16. 75</ls>; अबन्ध्ययत्नाश्च बभूवुरत्र ते <ls n="R.">3. 29</ls>; <ls>Ki. 1. 33</ls>. .²6 Not having the menses or menstrual discharge. .²7 (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Deprived or destitute of.
